content: Human-labeling session — econ-contention-with-enemy:easy seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a contested-economy drill. Your Construction Yard (fact), Ore Refinery (proc) and two harvesters (harv, unarmed ore trucks) sit at the west base, with two medium tanks (2tnk) on garrison. A shared ore patch lies just east; an enemy heavy tank (3tnk) is approaching from mid-map and targeting your harvesters. Within about 50 turns, reach economy value 1500, log at least one kill, and keep both harvesters alive.
